nodes.label: Base Evaluator
nodes.title: Base Evaluator Class
nodes.description: Provides shared serialization, specification building, and representation logic for all evaluator types, ensuring consistent handling of evaluator definitions and their configuration.

nodes.label: Case Evaluator
nodes.title: Abstract Case Evaluator
nodes.description: Abstract base class for evaluators that assess individual task outputs. Subclasses implement the `evaluate` method to perform specific checks on inputs, outputs, and expected results for a single case.

nodes.label: LLM Judge
nodes.title: LLM-based Judge Evaluator
nodes.description: Evaluates language model outputs by using another LLM to judge them against a specified rubric. It can optionally include the original input and expected output for comprehensive contextual assessment.

nodes.label: Contains Check
nodes.title: Content Containment Evaluator
nodes.description: Checks if the task output contains a specified value. Supports string substring checks, list/tuple item presence, and dictionary key-value pair matching, with an option for case sensitivity.

nodes.label: Type Instance Check
nodes.title: Type Instance Evaluator
nodes.description: Verifies if the task output is an instance of a type with a given name. It traverses the Method Resolution Order (MRO) of the output's type to find a matching class name or qualified name.

nodes.label: Report Evaluator
nodes.title: Abstract Report Evaluator
nodes.description: Abstract base class for evaluators that analyze an entire report of evaluation cases, producing experiment-wide analyses rather than per-case results. Useful for aggregate metrics and visualizations.

nodes.label: ROC AUC Analysis
nodes.title: ROC Curve and AUC Evaluator
nodes.description: Computes and plots the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve and its Area Under the Curve (AUC) from scored case data, providing insights into binary classifier performance and discrimination ability.

nodes.label: Precision-Recall Analysis
nodes.title: Precision-Recall Curve Evaluator
nodes.description: Calculates and plots the Precision-Recall curve from scored case data, along with its AUC. This is particularly useful for evaluating models on imbalanced datasets where positive cases are rare.

nodes.label: Kolmogorov-Smirnov Analysis
nodes.title: Kolmogorov-Smirnov Statistic Evaluator
nodes.description: Generates a Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) plot showing empirical Cumulative Distribution Functions (CDFs) for positive and negative cases, and computes the KS statistic to measure separation between score distributions.

nodes.label: Confusion Matrix Analysis
nodes.title: Confusion Matrix Generator
nodes.description: Constructs a confusion matrix from predicted and expected labels across all evaluation cases, providing a detailed breakdown of classification performance including true positives, false positives, etc.

nodes.label: Case Context
nodes.title: Context for Case Evaluation
nodes.description: Provides the necessary inputs, outputs, and metadata for a single evaluation case to a case-level evaluator, enabling it to perform its specific assessment.

nodes.label: Report Context
nodes.title: Context for Report Evaluation
nodes.description: Supplies the full report, including all evaluation cases, to a report-level evaluator for aggregate analysis and generation of experiment-wide metrics or visualizations.

nodes.label: AI Model
nodes.title: AI Model Interface
nodes.description: Represents an AI model used for various tasks, such as judging in the LLM Judge evaluator, providing a standardized interface for interaction with different model providers.

nodes.label: Report Analysis Output
nodes.title: Structured Report Analysis
nodes.description: A structured data type representing the output of a report-level evaluator, which can include plots, tables, scalar metrics, or other aggregate insights derived from the evaluation report.

nodes.label: Evaluation Reason Output
nodes.title: Detailed Evaluation Outcome
nodes.description: A structured result indicating a boolean evaluation outcome (pass/fail) along with an optional textual reason or explanation for that outcome, providing more context than a simple boolean.

nodes.label: Case Evaluation Output
nodes.title: General Evaluator Result
nodes.description: The general return type for case-level evaluators, which can be a scalar value, an EvaluationReason, or a mapping of evaluation names to either of these result types.
